package.name: humanoid_actuator_system
package.description: HumanoidActuatorSystem: the only production hardware_interface::SystemInterface in this robot (ADR-001). It owns joint identity, interface export, the immutable all-joint MIT tuple snapshot, SafetyKernel invocation, fault propagation, and transport lifecycle. Physical I/O is delegated to an ActuatorTransport plugin, which is what makes replacing the dual-STM32 USB path a configuration change rather than a rewrite.
